sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase: a show's content tags can now be checked too (⚙️ Settings, "Also check a Brucebase show's content tags", off by default while the remaining tag checks are tuned). A show whose News/Memorabilia tab shows a setlist should carry "setlist" (and "handwritten" or "printed" when the picture's name says so), one showing a ticket should carry "ticket", and one with an entry on its Storyteller or Eyewitness tab should carry "storyteller" or "eyewitness". A "storyteller" or "eyewitness" tag without its tab's entry is a ⚠️. The picture tags never are: a picture can sit on a news page the tab lists, or in its Flickr gallery. It reads only the page itself, with no request and no feed. Like the other tag checks, it is marked on the Tags card, in the preview window and in the year table's Tags column. On the wiki today it flags 154 shows. "news", "memorabilia", "bootleg", "livedl", "soundcheck" and "rescheduled" are not checked: the wiki does not tag them by a rule the page shows.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase: a show's place tags can now be checked too (⚙️ Settings, "Also check a Brucebase show's place tags", off by default while the remaining tag checks are tuned). A show should carry tags for the city, the US state or Canadian province ("newjersey(nj)") and the country its title names, "usa" or "canada" after a state or province, and "europe" or "oceania" for a country there. Like the other tag checks, it is marked on the Tags card, in the preview window and in the year table's Tags column; a place tag is never called not expected. A few names the wiki tags its own way ("West Germany" is "germany", "Atlantic City" is "atlanticcitynj") and the regions come from the Brucebase feed, so BruceParser keeps them up to date without a new script version. Without the feed the Tags card says the place is not checked. On the wiki today it flags 35 shows, most of them without "usa" or "canada", one with the city written "Los Angels". The venue's own tag will follow through the feed.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase: a show's tour tag can now be checked too (⚙️ Settings, "Also check a Brucebase show's tour tag", off by default while the remaining tag checks are tuned). A gig or a cancelled show whose date lies in a tour's dates should carry that tour's tag (both tags where two tours overlap), unless it is tagged "tour_no", the wiki's mark of a one-off show between a tour's dates. A tour tag whose tour has other dates is a ⚠️. Like the other tag checks, it is marked on the Tags card, in the preview window and in the year table's Tags column. The tours and their dates come from the Brucebase feed, so BruceParser keeps them up to date without a new script version. Without the feed the Tags card says the tour is not checked. Rehearsals, recordings, interviews and dates with "00" are not checked. On the wiki today it flags 49 shows, for example the four Bijou Cafe pages of December 1973 tagged "tour_wies" and the Brussels show of 2008 tagged "tour_rsng" instead of "tour_mgc".

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: The setting "Read the Brucebase feed" gave the file's size as about 25 KB; it is about 28 KB compressed now.
